viewer.sparse: Sparse vector: shown as the engine writes it.

edit.format: “{{column}}” is a vector column: write the value as a JSON array of numbers, for example [0.12, -0.03, 0.88]. To leave it NULL, use “$t(results:grid.setNull)”.
edit.dims: “{{column}}” holds vectors of {{expected}} dimensions and the value has {{got}}.
edit.range: “{{column}}” takes integers from {{min}} to {{max}}: number {{position}} of the vector is {{value}}.
edit.overflow: “{{column}}” stores {{element}} numbers, up to ±{{max}}: number {{position}} of the vector is {{value}}.
edit.empty: “{{column}}” doesn't take an empty vector: write its numbers, for example [0.12, -0.03, 0.88].
edit.skippedColumns: The vector columns ({{columns}}) are left out of the WHERE.

filter.onlyNull: “{{column}}” is a vector column: filter it by NULL or NOT NULL, or with an SQL condition from the filter's menu.

sort.local: vector columns aren't sorted on the server

compare.firstDiff: {{side}}: they differ from number {{position}} of {{dims}}. Double-click to see the whole vector.

designer.toggleHint: A similarity search index on a vector column
designer.notVectorColumn: Index “{{label}}” is a vector index and “{{column}}” isn't a vector column.
designer.noFilterColumns: Index “{{label}}” is a vector index: on this engine it takes only the vector column.
designer.rebuilt: Vector index “{{label}}” changes: it's dropped and created again, and rebuilding it can take a while on large tables.
